shortDescription: Stacked z-levels (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP with live see-below. Pass 33 see-below input parity is user-verified (render-aware right-click, elevation-lock hardening, drag-box select, targeter widening, hover readout); follow-up keeps selection across stairs/elevators/ladders. Designators out of scope.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-25)
**NEVER launch tests with the user's full modlist (isolated=false).** 900+ mods bury our diagnostics under 50+ unrelated startup/save-load errors. ALWAYS isolated=true with a minimal companionMods set (e.g. just Dubwise.DubsBadHygiene when a DBH test is needed) + build a fresh column via the dev action "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement". The user's real column SAVE was made under the full list so it can't load isolated — test on a freshly generated column instead. Non-isolated only if the user explicitly asks.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (identity x/z; -2.5 y is altitude/sort only; 0.85 per-object shrink about each thing's own center).
- Selection survives column view switches AND pawn level-changes via stairs. All levels real maps; viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap. Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- **See-below = RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through** (RimWorld input is welded to Find.CurrentMap). Shared pattern (pass 33): ONE render-aware hit-test (`BelowSelection.SelectablesUnderMouse` / `TryBelowRightClickCell`) + ONE input-scope adapter (`ABCurrentMapSwap` — point CurrentMap at the lower map around a read/action; plumb transform => same screen cell). Selection (in-place, no jump) + orders (stair routing) keep bespoke semantics; multi-frame drags reuse the swap for reads.
- **Designators OUT OF SCOPE (user decision pass 33):** "switch the view to that level to build/order" is acceptable.
- Logistics doctrine (pass 32): every ferry MONOTONE (storage=vanilla+capacity clamp; demand=shortfall+retention via PinnedByNativeNeed; in-flight ledger). Needs-bridge: postfix vanilla giver, re-run guard chain, probe linked levels, one-hop stairs job, per-pawn cooldowns. Work-migration hysteresis: post-arrival commitment cooldown, arrival-tick recharge, bumps only for level-linked maps.

## REMOVED FEATURES
SKYLIGHTS (round 7, postmortem pass 16). MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12, revisit dossier pass 22).

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · Batch A · mech charge crash gone · bill supply + mech RMB · **PASS 33 see-below input parity (all 5 items below) — user: "everything else seems to work"**.

# PASS 33 — SEE-BELOW INPUT PARITY (USER-VERIFIED)
1. **RMB building hit-test** — `BelowSelection.TryBelowRightClickCell` render-aware hit-test; RMB prefix snaps clickPos onto the below building/item/pawn under (or beside) the cursor before ShouldRedirect. Root cause was ResolveTargetMap keying target level off the RAW clicked cell's open-air terrain alone. Generic (DBH via vanilla FloatMenuOptionProvider_FromThing + WrapOptions, NO per-mod patch).
2. **Elevation-lock GroundMap hardening** — GroundMap() walks the vertical links when the groundMap field is null, so ShouldSuppressJump can't fail open. Hardens SameColumn + 2-hop RMB too.
3. **Cross-level DRAG-BOX select** (`Patch_Selector_SelectInsideDragBox_Below`) — below candidates via CurrentMap-swap + vanilla ThingSelectionUtility scan filtered VisibleFromAbove; vanilla category priority over COMBINED sky+below pool; sky via Select, below via AddInPlace (sky-first so dedup never wipes below). Only takes over when the box covers a visible below thing. Mixed sky+below intended.
4. **Targeter WIDENING** (`CrossLevelTargeting.TryHandleActionTargeter`) — action-only tool targeters (DBH connect-fixture-to-bed, cell pickers, modded, NO drafted attackers) resolve a below thing/cell via the targeter's own targetParams+validator and fire the action (no routing), CurrentMap pointed at the target level. Melee-squad action path unaffected.
5. **Hover MOUSEOVER READOUT** (`Patch_MouseoverReadout_Below`) — over a see-through cell, point CurrentMap at the lower map for the readout draw so the bottom-left panel reports the below thing/terrain.
- Temp [AB RMB diag]/[AB lock diag] diagnostics STRIPPED after verification.

## PASS 33 FOLLOW-UP (built green, NOT yet user-verified)
6. **Selection preserved across stairs/elevator/ladder** (`StairTransfer.Transfer`) — user report: selecting a pawn/group and having them cross a level lost the selection (DeSpawn drops it; only the single-pawn camera-follow path reselected). Now every transferring pawn that was selected is captured pre-DeSpawn and re-added in place post-spawn via `BelowSelection.RestoreSelected` (no camera yank, bypasses cross-map dedup so group-mates left behind stay selected). Covers groups, camera-follow off, lock on, and pawns ordered from another level. Sky->surface keeps them bracketed in the below view; other directions keep them selected (orders work) without a bracket.

## INTERACTION AUDIT (vanilla mouse/UI x see-below) — pass 33
✅ done · ❌ out of scope
- Select: single/double/shift left-click ✅; **drag-box ✅**; bracket ✅; inspect+gizmos of below-selected ✅; **selection kept across stairs ✅ (follow-up, pending verify)**.
- Info: **mouseover readout ✅ (hover)**; always-on floating labels over below things ❌ not built (offer if wanted).
- RMB orders: single/multi/building(generic)/attack/formation-drag/stairs ✅.
- Targeters: melee/ranged/ability/turret/hover-cursor ✅; **action-only tool targeters ✅**.
- Designators: ❌ OUT OF SCOPE per user; workaround = switch view.
- Camera: level view switch ✅; colonist-bar/alerts/letters jump ✅ (lock GroundMap hardened).

## OPTIONAL future (proposed, not committed)
Unify hit-test into one BelowInput.Resolve(). Always-on floating below-thing labels. Targeter hover-cursor validity for action targeters over below. Group camera-follow up/down stairs (currently single-pawn only).

# VANILLA PARITY SCAFFOLD (P0-P3 done passes 27-30; P4 verify-only backlog stands). COMPAT BUILT pass 31: WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky+basement · basement diagnostic · light diagnostic · RMB diagnostic · below-view diagnostic.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE (run ISOLATED + companion DBH + dev-built column)
**0-pre (PASS 33 follow-up, TOP): select a pawn AND a group, walk them through a stairway / elevator / ladder -> selection is KEPT (sky->surface: still bracketed in the below view).**
Pass-32 queue still pending: log-carousel dead, stair-thrash dead, ferry round-2, pass-31 compat session, below lighting, animal flow, BAM/Batch B/C, perf/CE-absent/translation/soak/publishing, P4 sweep.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 (VERIFIED incl. pass-33 building hit-test) · basement (VERIFIED) · haul/ferry (p32 monotone) · below lighting · animal flows · mech charge (VERIFIED) · work-migration commitment (p32) · elevation lock (VERIFIED, GroundMap hardened) · drag-box select (VERIFIED) · targeter widening (VERIFIED) · hover readout (VERIFIED) · **selection-across-stairs (p33 follow-up, pending)** · P0-P3 parity · pass-31 compat. REMOVED: skylights, mountain rivers. OUT OF SCOPE: cross-level designators.

## Compat

Robots/++ · Hauler's Dream+PUAH · Allow Tool · Ancient urban ruins · CE · Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF · Trader Airships, Hospitality · BAM · PO/Dubs Analyzer/TPT · WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-25 (33rd pass): See-below INPUT parity USER-VERIFIED ("everything else seems to work") — RMB building hit-test, elevation-lock GroundMap hardening, drag-box select, targeter widening, hover readout. Temp diagnostics stripped. NEW follow-up built green (pending verify): selection now survives a selected pawn/group crossing a stairway/elevator/ladder (was dropped on DeSpawn). Testing is ISOLATED + companion DBH + dev-built column per user directive.
